The wastewater treatment process will consist of ... chlorine disinfection. Prior to any wet weather or maintenance exercise discharge ... the Discharger will also dechlorinate the wastewater.
The Discharger will minimize discharges to Lower San Francisco Bay by using its 8.0-million-gallon (MG) Ecotone Project equalization basin to store peak flows.
The Discharger will use available basins to store solids containing the necessary microorganisms and reduce the potential for washout.

The Discharger plans to replace the aeration basin mechanical surface aeration devices with a fine-bubble aeration system that will provide sufficient aeration capacity ... to facilitate year-round nitrification.
The Discharger will rehabilitate and convert existing, unused secondary clarifiers to operate as denitrification basins.
